definitions.explanation: The outward behavior or demeanor that reveals or conceals one's true feelings or intentions.
A subtle sign or indication of something, especially an attitude or feeling that shows through one's behavior.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦{食|く}わぬ→食う：02657_kuu⟧{素振|そぶ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To act as if nothing happened.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{知|し}っている→知る：00458_shiru⟧{素振|そぶ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せなかった→見せる：01988_miseru⟧。
examples.english: He didn't show any sign that he knew.

examples.japanese: ⟦{平気|へいき}→平気：00095_heiki⟧な{素振|そぶ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{実|じつ}→実：28344_jitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{傷|きず}ついていた→傷つく：01934_kizutsuku⟧。
examples.english: She was acting like she was fine, but she was actually hurt.

examples.japanese: ⟦{怒|おこ}っている→怒る：00876_okoru⟧{素振|そぶ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There were signs that he was angry.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{帰|かえ}りたい→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧{素振|そぶ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せた→見せる：01988_miseru⟧。
examples.english: She showed signs of wanting to go home.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不満|ふまん}→不満：02497_fuman⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{素振|そぶ}り⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{見|み}せ→見せる：01988_miseru⟧ず、⟦{黙々|もくもく}→黙々：14712_mokumoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{働|はたら}いた→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: Without showing the slightest sign of dissatisfaction, he worked silently.

notes:
PRONUNCIATION:
{素振|そぶ}り (behavior/sign) vs. {素振|すぶ}り (practice swing in sports) — same kanji, different readings and meanings. This entry covers the そぶり reading.

KEY EXPRESSION:
⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦{食|く}わぬ→食う：02657_kuu⟧{素振|そぶ}り — "an innocent look," acting as if one knows nothing or has done nothing wrong. This is one of the most common uses.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～{素振|そぶ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧: to show signs of ~
- ～{素振|そぶ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せない→見せる：01988_miseru⟧: to not show any sign of ~
- ～な{素振|そぶ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to act/behave as if ~

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦{食|く}わぬ→食う：02657_kuu⟧{素振|そぶ}り: innocent look
- ⟦{平気|へいき}→平気：00095_heiki⟧な{素振|そぶ}り: composed behavior
- ⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧な{素振|そぶ}り: anxious behavior
- {素振|そぶ}り⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{見|み}せない→見せる：01988_miseru⟧: not show the slightest sign
